prompts.label: A｜囲いなし
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. EDIT Image 1 into a refined Japanese iPhone work-screen proposal. Image 1 is the UI and composition reference, Image 2 is the original exact rooftop pixel-art background. Preserve the same night artwork, small girl at her desk, colors and proportions. Keep the background full screen without a card/frame. One complete portrait phone-screen mockup, same aspect ratio as Image 1, no physical hardware, no collage, no external labels.
USER'S CRITICAL NEW PLACEMENT: keep scene title/rank/growth at TOP LEFT, but MOVE THE ELAPSED TIME, PAUSE AND STOP into ONE GROUP at the horizontal CENTER and SLIGHTLY BELOW THE VERTICAL CENTER. Center that group at about 61–63% of total screen height. It MUST NOT be near the bottom: do not place the timer/actions at 80–90% height as in Image 1. Leave a clear gap and unoccupied artwork between the group and the bottom tabs. The girl stays visible below the control group; do not move or resize her to make room. Control group should end before her head begins around 71–73% height.
Top left exact title "ネオンの向こうの屋上", restrained ~21pt Japanese type, underneath a tiny "4/5" and a genuinely THIN 2pt horizontal progress bar about 140pt long, filled 75%, plus small muted "進化まであと7分". No extra headline. A counting-up elapsed stopwatch "18:42", small caption "経過時間". Pause action: pause icon with clear small label "一時停止". Finish/stop action: stop-square icon with clear small label "停止". Both are usable 44pt minimum targets. Active work session, no start button, no duration picker, no countdown.
Keep "Night Signal" right-aligned close to the physical right edge around 41–43% screen height, over a low-opacity pale white LEFT SEMICIRCLE radial audio spectrum whose circle center is exactly on the right screen edge. The song/spectrum opens audio settings; no separate audio button. The audio group does not overlap the timer/actions below.
Bottom navigation remains at the actual bottom: three fine icons plus labels "作業", "コレクション", "設定", with 作業 selected using a small champagne underline. Keep it visually quiet and separate from the central session control group.
Warm ivory and muted gray UI, restrained champagne active accents, black-based style. Artwork remains dominant and unblurred except immediately behind a translucent control panel where specified. High-quality Japanese typography, clean alignment, no bright neon UI, no thick progress bar, no new product features, no extra statistics. Exact required text, no motivational slogans. Do NOT duplicate timer or controls at the bottom. All three variants must obey the SAME new placement; vary only the control group's styling/arrangement. VARIANT A — BARE INLINE CONTROLS. The lower-middle control group at 62% height is a single balanced horizontal composition, roughly 300pt wide. Time 18:42 in elegant 32pt digits on the left, caption above it; to its right, a modest 44pt cream filled circular pause button, then an outlined 44pt circular stop button. Tiny labels under the two circles. No enclosing card, no pill, no divider between buttons, no timer ring. Use only subtle soft text shadow and an almost imperceptible local readability gradient. The group floats lightly over the night view, leaving generous visible city and rooftop beneath it.
